I would like the display in VRChat client to match the display on the VRChat web site.

Also, the problem is not only the difference in the supported sites, the web page side is currently matched with a partial match, so all URLs containing “vk” (e.g. Vket Store) will show the icon for ВКонтакте.
I would add that site-specific shortlinks (such as gum.co for gumroad) should also be recognized for the non-generic icons.
Bluesky as well, now that they have a proper icon

details:
I would like to request some more icons for profile link.  It also helps with clarity on links so people know what they are pressing as I do assume most creators will like to link their work to their profile. I noted that you guys have ones for booth, twitter, twitch as well and I do believe extras that cater to the creator community will help. As you already have booth I would assume that gumroad, github, gitlabs and tip jars should fall under the same category.
Specifically ones as listed are most common in the creator community:
- gumroad
- GitHub
- payhip
- linktree
- Gitlab
- tipjars (such as Ko-fi, cashapp, paypal)
title: [1236] Please include icons to profile links such as gumroad/linktree/github/etc
